title: Model B semantic-information analysis: JRSI Round-2 reproducibility release
description: Version 2.0.0 reproducibility release supporting JRSI manuscript rsif-2026-0516, Counterfactual interventions reveal causal relevance of inherited sequence distinctions in a compositional-resampling model. This version contains the frozen Round-2 marginal-preserving (MP) evidence layer, corrected retained-information frontiers, causal-specificity controls, independent affinity-landscape replication, staged domain mapping, protocol-sensitivity and targeted confirmations, marginal diagnostics, validation records, exact source hashes, and clean-room regeneration workflow. Historical Gate-8/Round-1 material is retained as provenance and is not the current evidence base.
